Priya Rao: @finance I submitted my expense for the SF trip but missing an Uber receipt for 2025-05-14 (ride to SFO). Corporate card charged $42.75. Can a CC statement line work?
Ethan (Finance): Yes. Upload a screenshot of the card statement showing merchant, date, amount, and last4. Redact PII.
Priya Rao: Uploaded card-***/1234 (screenshot). I blurred customer names.
Liz Morales: I approve the ride. Can you add one-line business purpose?
Priya Rao: Added: "Client kickoff: Redwood API integration — dinner + ride".
Ethan (Finance): Missing receipt flow: card stmt + manager approval + justification.
Priya Rao: Also — corp card declined at Harbor Inn checkout so I paid $210 on personal card. How to get reimbursed?
Ethan (Finance): Submit as reimbursement. Attach hotel folio + proof of personal payment + note explaining decline. We'll try to reconcile corp card with bank but reimburse you ASAP.
Priya Rao: Uploaded hotel-folio.pdf and personal-cc-visa-3456.png. Notes say "Corp card declined at checkout — reimb requested."
finance-bot: Expense ticket #EXP-2025-4137 created and assigned to Ethan. ETA 3 business days.
Liz Morales: Approved hotel reimbursement. :+1:
Ethan (Finance): Checklist updated: Missing receipt -> card stmt + mgr approval; Card declined -> folio + personal proof + mgr approval; Per diem rules -> itemized receipts > $75; Policy: https://redwood.example.com/policies/expenses
Priya Rao: One more: client handed me $20 cash for part of dinner. How record?
Ethan (Finance): Add line: Dinner $120, Client reimbursement -$20, Net $100. Attach any proof (email/cash note).
Priya Rao: Done. Thanks! :blush:
Ethan (Finance): Reimbursement will be issued next payroll unless you request ACH sooner
